{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Governing elites have long used racism to divide working people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Left must understand the centrality of racism to capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Left must speak directly to how racism has hurt the interests of the white working class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The far Right in Europe and the United States has succeeded in speaking to the anger of people long abandoned by the bipartisan conservative and center-left consensus in favor of unbridled corporate globalization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump’s victory should show once and for all the dire consequences of leaving the Left’s response to economic insecurity in the hands of corporate-aligned centrists like the Clintons.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If Sanders had been the Democratic nominee, he certainly could have mobilized stronger working-class support against Trump.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If Sanders had been the Democratic nominee, his coattails could have put both houses of Congress in play.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Clinton failed to gain the support of many working- and middle-class whites by running a campaign overly focused on Trump’s character flaws rather than hammering home the Sanders-inspired platform proposals that would improve the lives of working people of all races.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Clinton failed to highlight raising the minimum wage.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Clinton failed to highlight opposing “free trade” agreements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Clinton failed to highlight creating good jobs through public investment in infrastructure and alternative energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party chose the wrong candidate and the wrong strategy, and now the United States is left with the most dangerous government in recent history.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
